questions.topic: An area from a scale factor
questions.learningObjective: Compute model area from real area
questions.stem: A real tank base has area 36 cm squared and scale factor 1:3. What is the model base area?
questions.explanation: Model area is real area divided by scale squared: 36 over 9 equals 4 cm squared. Multiplying would be wrong.
questions.hint: Divide real area by scale squared.

questions.topic: An inscribed circle and a square
questions.learningObjective: Compute area of an inscribed circle
questions.stem: A square tank of side 10 cm has an inscribed circle. What is the circle's area?
questions.explanation: Radius is 5 cm, so area is pi times 5 squared equals about 78.54 square cm. Using side as radius would be wrong.
